published_settings.geography: coordinates, row standardized W, diagonal zero
published_settings.MSE: Parametric bootstrap procedure Molina et al (2009), explicitly stated in English abstract p172; details/B/bias correction not given in Apuntes text.

reconstruction_decisions.primary_W: within poverty stratum directed Euclidean longitude/latitude kNN6, row normalized; based on local later scripts, not established author W
W_sensitivities: haversine kNN geometry sensitivity if feasible
reconstruction_decisions.missing_areas: all areas retained in latent SAR graph; only sampled response/variance enter restricted likelihood
reconstruction_decisions.variance_boundary: A=0 supported; rho then not identified
reconstruction_decisions.intervals: Primary naive parametric REML bootstrap B100 MSE; BC same draws descriptive sensitivity; Gaussian 95% intervals not specified in original article; no prediction clipping.
reconstruction_decisions.covariate_selection: freeze published table lists, no variable selection using holdout
reconstruction_decisions.outcome_covariate_inputs: fractions except Altitud in km, intercept=1
reconstruction_decisions.variance_regularization: none implicit; caller must document any GVF or floors
reconstruction_decisions.rho_bounds_rationale: CRAN sae1.3 Fisher update safeguard +/-0.999; final rounding to +/-1 in sae may be singular; retain interior bound. Expanded from +/-0.98 before final evaluation, no truth used.
